title: Second-order KL of an actual bounded affine probability perturbation
source_anchor: Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, August 20 2026, Exercise 1.7 / (1.E.1), printed p.43 / PDF p.55; explicit downstream use in Corollary 2.1.2, printed p.50 / PDF p.62.
target_statement: On a probability space, let f be a.e. strongly measurable, uniformly bounded a.e., and centered. For all sufficiently small real e the actual affine withDensity tilt is a probability with finite KL relative to the base law. The real KL minus e²∫f²/2 is little-o of e² on the full neighborhood of zero.
